sentences.text: This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Soro P.S. Case No. 495 of 2023 corresponding to Special Case No. 249 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned Special Judge, POCSO Balasore under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2) of IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. The prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected vide order dated 07.10.2023 passed by the learned ADJ-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Balasore in Special Case No. 249 of 2023.

3. Perusal of the rejection order dated 07.10.2023 reveals that apart from observation that the victim was aged below 18 years, the other reason for rejecting the prayer for bail that investigation was in progress and the nature and gravity of the offence.
4.

Since Mr. K.L. Mohapatra, learned counsel appearing from the virtual High Court at Balasore on behalf of the petitioner submits that the investigation has been completed in the meanwhile, I dispose of the bail application granting liberty to move for bail afresh before the learned court below.
5. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
.............................. (SAVITRI RATHO) JUDGE puspa Signed by: PUSPANJALI MOHAPATRA Designation: Personal Assistant Reason: Authentication Location: Orissa High Court
